nodes.label: rpc.queryContract
nodes.rationale: One-call read of a contract method, including the built-in spec for Stellar Asset Contracts, with named args and no manual ScVal work. isReadCall false means the result is only a simulation of a state-changing call, which still has to be signed through contract.Client. getContractMethods lists the callable interface from the contract id.

nodes.label: getLedgerEntries
nodes.rationale: Read a raw persistent contract-data ledger key only when that key is not exposed as a contract method. Decode the stored ScVal with scValToNative.

nodes.label: NotFoundError
nodes.rationale: Typed error from @stellar/stellar-sdk. horizon.loadAccount rejects with NotFoundError when the account is unfunded; treat that native balance as 0. Submission failures are different: Horizon returns result codes under error.response.data.extras.result_codes.
